label: excellent
notes: Excellent Practitioner submission. React component with proper state management, accessible form, error handling, responsive layout. Minor deduction: no loading skeleton on fetch, aria-live region missing for dynamic updates.

label: good
notes: Functional React component with useState but no async fetch pattern — hardcoded data. No form, no error handling, no quantity input. CSS is reasonable but no responsive breakpoints. Missing aria labels.

label: failing
notes: Attempts React but misuses hooks (useState called conditionally after early return), no real state management, inline styles everywhere, no accessibility. Shows awareness of React but fundamental misunderstandings of hooks rules and component patterns.

label: borderline_pass
notes: Solid React, proper hooks, async fetch with try/catch and loading state. Missing quantity selector, no form element (just a button), responsive CSS but no grid layout. Good accessibility for what's there. Credential-worthy at this level.
